description: Native iPhone and iPad console for herdr: watch and drive coding agents on your machines over SSH, in Herdr TUI or the Herdr desktop app (herdr-core), with a real libghostty terminal, native Chat, QR pairing, and push notifications when an agent needs you

### Added

- Connect to herdr-core Hosts over SSH. Adding a Host by hand detects what the machine runs and offers herdr-core to confirm, without starting anything; a Linux Host whose core is not running offers Start herdr-core after a confirmation. The Console follows the Herdr desktop app's spaces and tabs, read-only, and places other Terminals by launch directory. Known coding programs, also when `npx` or `npm exec` starts them, and programs that report a status are Agents with their Program Status, and Pins are kept per Host. Live terminals share one connection, reach any number of viewers and pass every key to the program. A kept Terminal that loses its program shows Restarting and reattaches to the restored shell by itself, a program that exits shows ended with its exit code and no reattach, New Agent stays open and says so when an agent's program has already ended, another core answering at the same socket ends an open terminal rather than joining its Terminal at the same address and refuses what a detail still open on the old core sends by address, through a reconnect until its row is opened again, and Host detail names variables leaked into the core. Staged Images and Files work on macOS and Linux core Hosts. Agents cannot be renamed on these Hosts. (#535; PR #538)
- Agent List Fields on a herdr-core Host starts from the terminal's title, then its directory, and offers the Terminals' labels as fields, with no Sync from plugin. (#555; PR #538)
- Read a Claude Code Agent's conversation in Chat on a Linux herdr-core Host. Heeler finds the conversation from the Agent's own process when Chat opens and when its status, turn or foreground program changes, never on a timer and never by guessing, follows `/clear` and `/resume`, and reads from the `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` the Agent itself runs with. Without that evidence Chat says it can't tell, and an Agent that keeps no conversation says which variable stops it. A Chat open when its Agent ends or restarts stays on the conversation, says what became of the Agent, and follows the next Claude Code at that address. (#579; PR #538)
- Open Chat for Codex and Grok Build on a Linux herdr-core Host, each of which passed its check there with a signed-in account (Codex 0.165.0 started with `--no-daemon` and Grok Build 1.0.70, on herdr-core 0.1.13). Heeler binds the conversation from the rollout a `--no-daemon` Codex holds open, Grok Build's one matching session row, or the id Heeler started OpenCode 2.1 or later with, reading under the Agent's own `CODEX_HOME` or `GROK_HOME`. A Codex on the shared daemon says to reopen it with `codex resume --no-daemon`, after `codex app-server daemon stop` if Codex say

# Heeler **A native iOS companion app for [herdr](https://herdr.dev) — an agent-first terminal runtime.** [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler?style=flat-square&color=E8B923&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler/stargazers) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: Apache 2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache_2.0-6F42C1?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Swift](https://img.shields.io/badge/Swift-6-F05138?logo=swift&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://www.swift.org) [![iOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/iOS-18%2B-000000?logo=apple&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://developer.apple.com/ios/) [![App Store](https://img.shields.io/badge/App_Store-available-0D96F6?logo=apple&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/heeler-for-herdr/id6797263135) English | [简体中文](./README-zh.md) | [日本語](./README-ja.md)
--- Heeler is an independent **herdr mobile client** and agent console for Claude Code, Codex, and other coding Agents on iPhone and iPad. Agents run on your own Hosts in Herdr TUI or the Herdr desktop app (herdr-core); Heeler connects over SSH. Monitor multiple Agents across machines, sorted by who needs you, then open a live terminal or supported Chat conversation to send instructions. ## Screenshots | Agent Console | Live terminal | Chat | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | | Keyboard | Changes | Terminals | | --- | --- | --- | | |
